environment.description: Same banking microservice on EKS. Traffic ingresses through an Envoy-based gateway (Gloo Edge 1.14) with a custom ext_authz filter chain. The ext_authz gRPC service implements WebSocket-specific CSRF protection: on HTTP Upgrade requests with Connection: Upgrade, it extracts the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol subprotocol header and validates it contains a per-session HMAC token (derived from the session cookie value + server-side secret via HMAC-SHA256). The token is rotated every 5 minutes and cached in Redis with TTL. The ext_authz service returns DENY (403) if the subprotocol header is missing, malformed, or contains an invalid/expired HMAC. PgBouncer 1.21 configured with prepared_statement_mode=server (server-side prepared statements with dealloc_on_rotation=yes). Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the pod exclusively from the Gloo Edge gateway pods (label selector: gloo=gateway), preventing any direct pod-to-pod WebSocket connections that bypass the ext_authz check.

config.network_policy: ingress only from gloo=gateway labeled pods
